$comment: Editorial layer for the generated cheat sheet. The LIST of entries is never here: it comes from model.json, and test/cheatsheet/ fails when the two disagree in either direction. What lives here is the part a catalogue cannot derive: which domain a skill belongs to, and what a hook actually does — hook .sh files are generic adapters and carry no description of their own.

skillGroups.title: Method and flow
skillGroups.blurb: How work is framed before and after the code is written.

skillGroups.title: Code architecture
skillGroups.blurb: Where the boundaries are, and who owns which type.

skillGroups.title: Boundaries and production
skillGroups.blurb: What happens where the system meets something it does not control.

skillGroups.title: Quality, tests and interface
skillGroups.blurb: Proving the thing works, and that it is worth looking at.

skillGroups.title: Delivery and tickets
skillGroups.blurb: From a validated plan to a merged pull request.

skillGroups.title: The harness on itself
skillGroups.blurb: How the doctrine stays true as the project moves.

hookGroups.title: Blocking and protection
hookGroups.blurb: The floor that stops an action rather than reporting it afterwards.

hooks.block-dangerous-bash: Refuses destructive shell before it runs: recursive deletes, force pushes, history rewrites.
hooks.block-protected-push: Refuses a push to a protected branch, so the remote is never the last line of defence.
hooks.protect-sensitive-files: Refuses edits to secrets, keys, lockfiles and other single-writer paths.
hooks.secret-in-content: Refuses a write whose content carries a credential, even into an unprotected file.

hookGroups.title: Tests and TDD
hookGroups.blurb: The order of work, enforced rather than recommended.

hooks.tdd-guard: Refuses production code with no failing test behind it, at the strictness the project declared.
hooks.no-only-no-skip: Refuses a focused or skipped test reaching a commit, where it would silently shrink the suite.
hooks.test-name-lint: Refuses a test name that describes the implementation instead of the behaviour.
hooks.pre-PR-review-evidence: Requires the review evidence a pull request claims to have.
hooks.stop-typecheck: Typechecks at the end of a session, so a green run cannot end on a broken tree.

hookGroups.title: Type safety
hookGroups.blurb: The escape hatches that quietly undo a strict configuration.

hooks.no-any-grep: Refuses a new `any`, the fastest way to lose every guarantee downstream.
hooks.no-as-cast-grep: Refuses an `as` cast that asserts what the compiler was about to prove.
hooks.no-null-grep: Refuses a bare `null` where the project models absence explicitly.
hooks.tsc-noemit-precommit: Runs the typechecker before the commit lands, not after CI says so.

hookGroups.title: Cleanliness and refactoring
hookGroups.blurb: Keeping the diff readable and the vocabulary stable.

hooks.no-console-log-grep: Refuses a `console.log` in committed code; the project logger exists for this.
hooks.auto-format: Formats on write, so formatting never appears in a behavioural diff.
hooks.ubiquitous-language-lint: Refuses a name that contradicts the domain vocabulary the project settled on.
hooks.refactor-named-grep: Requires a refactor to name the Fowler transformation it applies.
hooks.tidying-commit-prefix: Keeps tidyings in their own commit, separate from behaviour change.

hookGroups.title: Frontend and design
hookGroups.blurb: The interface floor a screenshot would not catch.

hooks.no-ai-design-slop: Refuses the generated-UI tells: gradient hero, mid hierarchy, decorative motion.
hooks.anti-ai-slop-grep: The same judgement at the text level, on copy that reads as generated.
hooks.axe-precommit: Runs accessibility checks before the commit, not at review time.
hooks.viewport-screenshot-gate: Requires both viewports to have been looked at before a UI change ships.

hookGroups.title: Architecture, migrations and cost
hookGroups.blurb: The changes whose damage only shows up later.

hooks.boundary-direction-check: Refuses an import that points the wrong way across a package boundary.
hooks.migration-lint: Refuses a migration that cannot run without downtime.
hooks.migration-pr-template: Requires a migration pull request to carry its rollback and backfill plan.
hooks.llm-cost-precommit: Flags a model call whose cost profile changed without anyone deciding it.
hooks.large-cl-grep: Flags a changelist too large to review honestly.

hookGroups.title: Session and measurement
hookGroups.blurb: What the harness records about its own usefulness.

hooks.sessionstart-context: Loads the project's standing context once, at the start of a session.
hooks.activation-meter: Records which skills actually loaded, which is what `status` reports as used.
hooks.outcome-meter: Records what a session produced, so effectiveness is measured rather than assumed.
hooks.trim-large-output: Bounds oversized tool output before it consumes the context window.

agentGroups.title: Read-only audit
agentGroups.blurb: Fresh context, no write access: they judge, they do not fix.
